newsitem.title: QATAR: ATHLETICS-CHRISTIE TO COMPETE IN QATAR.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-CHRISTIE TO COMPETE IN QATAR.

text.p: Former Olympic champion Linford Christie will compete in Qatar next month, the organisers said on Tuesday.

Christie, 100 metres gold medallist at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics, features among an array of top athletes down to race at the first-ever Qatar International meeting at Doha's 50,000-capacity Khalifa stadium on April 24.

Namibian sprinter Frankie Fredericks, American 400 metres world record-holder Butch Reynolds, Zambian 400 hurdler Samuel Matete and leading Kenyans William Tanui, Paul Bitok and Joseph Keter are also scheduled to compete.
Christie's British compatriots in the line-up include John Regis (200 metres), Roger Black, Jamie Baulch (both 400 metres), Colin Jackson and Tony Jarrett (both 110 metre hurdles).
